styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Jinci Temple, the old city wall and Shanxi's deep past.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Shanxi noodles, vinegar and hearty street eats.

stays.why: Main east-west avenue; bus 1 runs along it and many sights and shops are close.
Easiest for early trains and budget hotels; short taxi rides to the centre.
Good base toward Jinci Temple in the southwest; quieter streets.
Central square with shops and food nearby; easy walking and buses.

food: Try Shanxi noodles: knife-cut noodles (daoxiao mian) and hand-pulled noodles, often with a vinegar-based sauce.
Shanxi aged vinegar is the local pride. Look for vinegar shops and taste before you buy.
Breakfast: steamed buns, millet porridge and fried dough sticks at small street shops, cheap and filling.
Look for local wheat dishes like mao'erduo and kaolaolao; portions are large, so share.
Prices are low: a simple noodle meal is often around ¥10–30. Check menus for prices before ordering.
more_time: Add a day trip to Pingyao old town by train; check times and tickets on the day.
Swap one city day for the Shanxi Museum if you like history and artefacts.
Spend a half day at Jinci Temple and its gardens if you have not already.

recommend.why: One night covers the old city and Jinci; add a night for a Pingyao day trip.

month_notes: Cold and dry: highs near 3°C, lows around -7°C. Pack a warm coat.
Still cold: highs near 7°C, lows around -5°C. Few rainy days.
Warming up: highs near 14°C, lows near 0°C. Light layers work.
Pleasant spring: highs near 20°C, lows near 6°C. Some rain, about 6 days.
Great month: highs near 26°C, lows near 12°C. Comfortable for walking.
Warm and mostly dry: highs near 30°C, lows near 17°C. Carry water.
Hot and wet: highs near 30°C, lows near 20°C, about 12 rain days.
Hot with rain: highs near 28°C, lows near 18°C, about 12 rain days.
Cooling down: highs near 24°C, lows near 13°C. Good for sightseeing.
Crisp autumn: highs near 17°C, lows near 6°C. Bring a jacket.
Chilly: highs near 10°C, lows near 0°C. Few rainy days.
Cold again: highs near 3°C, lows near -6°C. Winter gear needed.

climate_guide.summary: Continental climate with cold, dry winters and warm summers; most rain falls in July and August.

items.title: Best time: April to June and September to October
items.text: Mild highs of 17–26°C and fewer rain days. Good for temples and walking.

items.title: Winter is cold and dry
items.text: December to February highs are only 3–7°C with lows below freezing. Pack a heavy coat.

items.title: Rain peaks in July and August
items.text: About 12 rain days each month. Carry an umbrella and plan indoor sights.

items.title: Summer is warm
items.text: June to August highs reach 28–30°C. Go out early or late and drink water.

items.title: Autumn is crisp
items.text: October highs near 17°C and November near 10°C. Bring a warm layer.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers for spring and autumn, a heavy coat for winter, and rain gear for July and August.

transit.best: Metro and buses for the centre; taxis or Didi for longer trips.

modes.text: Lines run across the city; fares are up to ¥6 depending on distance.
Local buses cost ¥1 per ride; bus 1 runs along Yingze Dajie.
Taxis start at ¥8 flagfall; expect around ¥15–25 for cross-town trips. Didi is the main ride-hailing app; Uber does not operate in China.
Driving is busy and parking is tight; walking and buses are easier in the centre.
Walking works well in the flat centre; bikes and shared bikes also work well on flat central streets.
